<function name="SetHeaderHeight" parent="DListView" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Sets the height of the header line of the <page>DListView</page>.

See also <page>DListView:SetDataHeight</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="height" type="number">The new height to set. Default value is 16.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
